claims.claim: Pasting the full leaked Fable prompt makes Sonnet equal to Fable.
claims.reason: Prompt text cannot transfer model weights or provider-side capabilities.

claims.claim: Replacing Claude Code's system prompt is better than appending.
claims.reason: Replacement can remove native tool, environment, permission, and safety scaffolding.

claims.claim: Starting on Fable then switching to Sonnet preserves Fable intelligence.
claims.reason: Visible artifacts persist; hidden inference and model weights do not. The model switch also warms a separate cache.

claims.claim: A giant prompt always improves quality.
claims.reason: Large repeated instructions can reduce adherence and trigger unnecessary reasoning.

claims.claim: Separate fresh-context roles can improve review.
claims.reason: Independent contexts reduce self-critique contamination and are recommended in Fable guidance.

claims.claim: All work should use max effort.
claims.reason: Effort should be tied to remaining judgment; deterministic work gains nothing from extra reasoning.
Every configured role uses model: sonnet; no other API is called.
